# CLI: Backup

Only `hcm-3` is supported. `--project-id` does not scope these reads.
Backup Center is separate from `volume` snapshots; see
[Backup Center](Backup.md).

Every list prints `{"Items": [...]}` with page metadata beside `Items`,
so a `--query` starts with `Items`.

## list-backends

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
vngcloud backup list-backends
```

## list-policies

Kind: Read.

Reads one page. `--page` defaults to 1 and `--size` defaults to 200.
Hourly, weekly, and monthly schedule details are not included, only their
enable flags.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--page` | `int` |  |
| `--size` | `int` |  |

```sh
vngcloud backup list-policies \
  --query 'Items[].{ID:ID,Name:Name,Default:IsDefault}' --output table
```
